v1_outcome: insufficient_fixed_cohort_yield; no converter/model outcome or fitting
reason: Short shared inputs joined unrelated works into large source components. Excluding short-context targets before relation closure preserves every leakage relation among the retained inputs.
scope: Conditional source-exact research on left context of 8-64 characters; not overall IME accuracy, independent Gold or final Test
source_target_filter: Apply after the original per-document bottom-hash selection; no replacement targets; retain original source partitions

wikipedia_extension.source: Same pinned 2026-08-01 dump and all v1 historical article exclusions
wikipedia_extension.selection: SHA256 canonical JSON [20261105, jawiki, page_id, sample] modulo 100 equals 1; disjoint from v1 slot 0
wikipedia_extension.reason: Reserve one extra fixed article group before converter outcomes to allow 50000 eligible training rows after source-exact candidate verification

sources: Reuse all immutable v1 Wiki/Aozora targets plus the fixed slot-1 Wikipedia extension; no new Aozora requests
isolation: Retain all v1 source/input relations and quarantine the entire surviving cross-partition or historical component; never move evaluation source members into training

cohorts.selection: Lowest stable-ID hash order after isolation; evaluation fixed before converter outcomes. Training uses the first eligible rows in that order. wiki_small and mixed Wikipedia rows are nested subsets of wiki_large.

labels: Unchanged v1 source-exact weak supervision; dictionary-unique reading is not independent contextual truth
candidate_contract: One immutable bound reference-exporter snapshot per unique reading; validate every batch, retain failed readings and evaluation misses

training.sampling: Seeded shuffled full-cohort cycles, carry incomplete cycles into the next full batch
training.loss: Unchanged Issue-21 C2 masked cross entropy, label smoothing 0.05; no new teacher or language pretraining
training.model_selection: None; final step only for every cohort and seed
training.evaluation_access: Only after all nine fits and checkpoints are complete; no per-epoch evaluation or old-dev tuning
training.artifact_hashes: Commit exact cohort/cache/environment/implementation hashes before fitting

reporting.reference: Frozen Issue-29 checkpoint on the same new conditional population
reporting.promotion: No model adoption, gate tuning, production change or release from this weak-label experiment
